release_notes:
Updating is smoother. UC PACS now reopens by itself when an update finishes, and the update no longer stops partway to ask you to close programs.

Going back to an earlier version works again. Before, it stopped with "Couldn't back up your database."

The notes in this update window are now easy to read in dark mode.

The study list now always fills the width of the window. Its columns grow and shrink with the window, so there is no empty space on the right and no sideways scrolling.

Admins can now save the study list as a spreadsheet.

Uninstalling now asks about each item before removing it, and no longer leaves an empty folder behind.

The download is a little smaller than before.

history.release_notes:
The study list now always fills the width of the window. Its columns grow and shrink with the window, so there is no empty space on the right and no sideways scrolling.

Admins can now save the study list as a spreadsheet.

Uninstalling now asks about each item before removing it, and no longer leaves an empty folder behind.

The download is a little smaller than before.

UC PACS now checks its licence key with us when it is set up, and won't finish setup with a key we don't recognise.

It now signs you out properly when the computer is left sitting idle. Before, it warned you that it would and then stayed open.

Pulling the text out of a scanned report works again.

Your clinic name can now be filled in automatically on scans that arrive without one. Turn it on under Settings, System, Clinic Defaults.

The download is around half the size it used to be.
This version has been withdrawn. A newer one is on the way.
